purpose: Test whether the two frozen white-coloured sister systems share present-day establishment-surface proxies more consistently than they share current RSDS direction.

input_cohort.selection_rule: Reuse the frozen balanced four-taxon cohort without adding, dropping or reweighting records based on establishment-surface outcomes.

open_surface_fraction_500m.interpretation: Open recruitment/establishment surface proxy; not direct disturbance history.

hand_median_250m.source: ASF Global 30 m Height Above Nearest Drainage v1 from Copernicus GLO-30 2021
hand_median_250m.interpretation: Low drainage-relative terrain/floodplain opportunity proxy; not direct flood frequency or disturbance.

spatial_sensitivity.rule: Repeat sister-system contrasts after collapsing observations to taxon x 0.05-degree cell medians.

decision_rule.per_proxy_robust_shared_direction: Both sister systems must show the preregistered sign at observation level and after 0.05-degree cell aggregation.
decision_rule.multi_proxy_shared_establishment_context: Both primary proxies pass robust shared direction.
decision_rule.single_proxy_shared_establishment_contex: Exactly one primary proxy passes robust shared direction.
decision_rule.no_shared_establishment_proxy: Neither primary proxy passes robust shared direction.

comparison_reference.comparison_question: Do establishment-surface proxies replicate direction across both sister systems more consistently than current RSDS?

worldcover.tile_scheme: 3 x 3 degree COG tiles in EPSG:4326

hand.dataset: Global 30m Height Above Nearest Drainage v1 / Copernicus DEM 2021
hand.tile_scheme: 1 x 1 degree COG tiles aligned to GLO-30

claim_boundary: Static 2021 land cover is not a measurement of historical or recurrent disturbance.
HAND is drainage-relative terrain, not observed flooding, safe-site availability or recruitment.
A repeated proxy direction does not establish selection, adaptation or the environmental state at the colour transition.
Failure of these proxies does not falsify all disturbance or demographic-gate mechanisms.
The two systems are lineage comparisons, not independent randomized experiments.
